topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Employee handbook code of conduct; POL-01 sanctions statement adopted 2026-08-31
gap: No security-specific commitment signed by staff yet

control_description: No board; the majority owner will receive a quarterly security and ERP status briefing starting 2026 Q4
gap: No recorded owner oversight of security

control_description: General Manager, Operations Manager (OT owner), and IT Manager (security lead) designated in POL-01; risk acceptance levels defined
Operators hold state licenses and complete continuing education; no security competence requirements for OT roles
Sanctions and accountability in POL-01 4.7; security duties being added to job descriptions
Security-relevant information for OT is missing: no current inventory, network diagram, or retained logs
gap: No reliable information to operate controls
remediation: OT inventory and diagram (POAM-015); log forwarding (POAM-012)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies approved 2026-08-31 and posted; acknowledgments being collected; awareness training at hire only
Customer and regulator communications established: public notice SOP and templates, primacy agency contacts, consumer confidence report, customer service line

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives defined: safe and reliable drinking water, compliance with SDWA, protection of customer data
Risk assessment per SP 800-30 completed 2026-07-24 (P01) and used as the RRA cyber addendum
Dual approval for payments over $25,000; no documented fraud risk assessment; no call-back check on bank detail changes
remediation: Fraud risk review; call-back verification (P01 R-014)

control_description: No process to assess risk from significant changes; the anomaly detection pilot and CIS move went live without review
remediation: Change risk review in POL-01 and P10 governance

control_description: First independent control assessment completed 2026-08 (P07); no ongoing monitoring
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M with owners and dates; reported to the General Manager monthly

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected against P01 risks; most OT controls not yet implemented
gap: 36 of 64 SSP controls only partly implemented

control_description: Business IT general controls exist (MFA, patching); OT general controls weak

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Five policies approved 2026-08-31; OT procedures not written
remediation: OT procedures (remote access, program mode, backups)

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Business systems use SSO with MFA; OT uses shared and default credentials and password-only remote access
Account requests approved by managers; OT accounts outside the identity provider
Role-based access in business systems; shared HMI login; departed staff kept VPN accounts
gap: Least privilege and removal not enforced for OT

control_description: Card access at plants and control room; fenced and alarmed remote sites; cameras
Media wiped before disposal; no certificates of destruction; no customer record disposal procedure

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: IT/OT firewall exists; remote paths password-only; modems were internet-exposed; flat OT network

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: VPN and cloud tunnel encrypted; radio telemetry unencrypted (accepted); RRA folder over-shared

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: Antivirus on business endpoints and HMIs (HMI definitions updated monthly by hand); no allowlisting on OT

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: No vulnerability scanning; no configuration baselines for OT

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: No security monitoring of OT; cloud logs at defaults
Operators evaluate process alarms each shift; no security event triage
remediation: Weekly review once monitoring is live

control_description: P08 runbook approved 2026-08-31; not yet exercised
Manual operation drilled; no OT recovery procedure or offline logic backups
Integrator changes scheduled but not authorized, tested, or recorded; AI model updates deployed by vendor without review
gap: No change management for OT or the AI model
remediation: Change procedure with test and approval

control_description: ERP, generators, emergency interconnect, and cyber insurance in place

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: CIS vendor SOC 2 reviewed (vendor-soc2-review.csv); integrator contract has no security terms
